name: Budino di Riso
description: Individual Florentine rice pudding cakes baked in shortcrust pastry shells with lemon zest and vanilla.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with unsalted butter.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pizza dough and dried oregano until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the Parmesan cheese with the chicken stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 35 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with basil or a dusting of mascarpone.
Slice or portion into servings and serve.
tips: This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
